assessment—general medicine department "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;I, b.manaswini\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eintern of 2k17 batch\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ewas posted in department of general medicine on dates 02\/01\/23 to 03\/03\/23 including psychiatry \u0026nbsp;from dates 15 jan to 30 jan\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral medicine was my first posting in internship and reported enthusiastically on date and alloted unit 1 under pgs \u0026nbsp;dr. Prachethan and dr vivek sir . I took a little bit of time to cope up with process but got set by 1 week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn the very first day i monitored blood transfusion whose hb was 6mg\/dl until 9pm on non duty day, after that patient was taken over by obs gyn department for some gynaecological issues .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn op day there were nearly 70 pts and recorded nearly 30 patients vitals and among them few are admitted\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy very first case was very intrested pt presented with slurring of speech and decresed tone she got admitted and i took interest in that case from starting to end till dicharged . This case also helped me to diagnose my friends \u0026nbsp;mother who presented with same symptoms even before admitted into hospital.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere is the case\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/5536068467450883613\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/5536068467450883613\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEveryday at 8 am starts with updating soap notes and fever chat and posting in respective groups \u0026nbsp;and pajrs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere were 2 acute pancreatitis cases admitted at same time with h\/o alcohol intake . They were referred to psychiatric department after proper treatment and with help of rajkumar \u0026nbsp;sir (clinical psychologist) in kims made sure they got admitted in de addiction centre\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/4759612514403448651\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/4759612514403448651\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/5901961404124202593\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.blogger.com\/blog\/post\/edit\/7284845935636900439\/5901961404124202593\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd in 15 days i learned how to set up iv line , how to send samples and interpret results and abga \u0026nbsp;interpretations , also it was a hectic 2 weeks duration after that for 15 days i was posted in psychiatry\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was like rest period from hectic unit duties in general medicine, there I learned how to take psychiatry history taking in detail and some interesting cases like schizophrenia , ocd , depression , etc . De addiction was full of cases those who wanted to quit alcohol and smoking . And also i had a good time to prepare for my entrance exam\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter 15 days i was posted in icu , nephrology and wards , monitored all patients and also ventilatory patients learned how to take abg samples inserted foleys catheters and assisted central lines and monitored dialysis patients , saw a patient who has psvt and learned drug of choice as adenosine and learned basic ecg findings,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnd after i was posted in units for 15 days , every morning starts with updating of soap notes and fever charts and posting it in groups followed my pgs orders and discharged many patients with discharge summaries and \u0026nbsp;follow up medication ,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy other blogs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E88 y\/f with altered sensorium\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca
